service.name: vLLM
service.description: Open models on our own GPU server with vLLM. Nothing leaves the server.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.help: How freely the model words its answer: 0 gives the most repeatable answers, 1 or more more varied ones. Empty uses the model's default.

max_output_tokens.name: Max answer length (tokens)
max_output_tokens.help: Upper limit for the length of the answer, in tokens (about 3/4 of a word each). Your service group may set a lower limit.

autotag.name: Tag with AI
autotag.description: Tags the text or image with categories you give or existing tags you pick, or lets the model suggest tags

labels.name: Categories
labels.help: Comma-separated categories to choose from, or pick existing tags (their descriptions help the model). Leave empty to let the model suggest tags.

multi_label.name: Allow several tags
multi_label.help: Check this if a file can get more than one category.

max_tags.name: Max suggested tags
max_tags.help: Only when no categories are given: how many tags the model may suggest.

instructions.name: Extra guidance
instructions.help: Optional, e.g. 'tag the main topic only' or 'answer in Finnish'.

gpt-oss-20b.name: gpt-oss 20B
gpt-oss-20b.description: OpenAI's open-weight reasoning model. Text only.

qwen2.5-vl-7b.name: Qwen2.5-VL 7B
qwen2.5-vl-7b.description: Vision-language model; reads images, handwriting and tables well.
